doc: Activates a table slot (D_80086C00[a0]) for playback/display. Skips entirely if a0==-1 or the slot's field_0==-1 (empty slot). Otherwise: calls func_80056A08(); records the slot's field_0 into the "current slot" global D_80086D50[0]; stores the sub-id arg (a2) into D_80086D48[0]; sets a base value D_800869B0[0]=0x10000; copies the slot's field_4 (a data/buffer pointer) into D_80085FA4[0]; calls func_800599B0(); then, depending on whether arg1's low byte is nonzero, sets a mode pair (D_800737A4/D_80085F98) to (1,0) or (0,1) and writes the corresponding mode value (1 or 4) back into the slot entry's field_2.
